{{Hatnote|This page documents a constructed card pool. Official tournament documents remain authoritative.}}
'''Premiere &ndash; Reflections II''' (display name '''Premiere - Reflections II''') is a constructed environment whose legal pool is the printed Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Reflections II]].

The [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]] (Prem-RefII) at the 2021 World Championship weekend in Washington, D.C. was played in this format. It is a narrower printed pool than [[Premiere - Theed Palace]] (Premiere through Theed Palace / GEMP Decipher Cards Only) and a different pool from [[Premiere - Reflections III]] (the [[2001 Decipher World Championship]]).
